Pick up a sprayer.desc: This action enables the uav to pick up a sprayer if the uav is on the ground and currently carrying nothing. This action incurs a cost of 5. For example, the uav can pick up a sprayer from the ground if the uav and sprayer are both on the ground, and incur 5 units cost.
Pick up a sprayer.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to load [object1] on [position1] if the uav is on [position1] and is [state1]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].

Put down a sprayer.desc: This action enables the uav to put down a sprayer that it is holding if the uav is on the ground. This action incurs a cost of 4. For example, the uav puts down a sprayer on the ground if it is on the gound, and incur 4 units cost.
Put down a sprayer.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to unload [object1] if the uav is on [position1]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].

uav takes off from the ground.desc: This action enables the uav to take off from the ground and start flying. This action incurs a cost of 6. For example, the uav can take off from the ground and be in the air, and incur 6 units cost.
uav takes off from the ground.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to take off from [position1] and start [state1]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].

uav lands on the ground.desc: This action enables the uav to land on the ground after flying. This action incurs a cost of 7. For example, the uav can land on the ground after flying and incur 7 units cost.
uav lands on the ground.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to land at [position1] after [state1]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].

uav flies to another position on the cei.desc: This action enables the uav to fly to another position from the current position on the ceiling, the uav must be in the air all the time. This action incurs a cost of 1. For example, the uav can fly from position_1 to position_2 on the ceiling, and incur 1 unit cost.
uav flies to another position on the cei.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to move from [position1] to [position2], the uav must be in [state1]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].

uav paints a position on the ceiling.desc: This action enables the uav to paint a position with specific color on the ceiling, the uav must hold the sprayer with that specific color, and must be in the air to paint. This action incurs a cost of 1. For example, if the UAV is flying and equipped with a red sprayer, it can paint position_1 red on the ceiling, and incur 1 unit cost.
uav paints a position on the ceiling.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to paint at [position1] with [state1], the uav must load [object1] with [state1], the uav also need to be in [state2]. This action will increase [value1] by [value2].
